clue.text: Reported piece of ship's canvas in public auction

indicators.note: reported means spoken of, so the word for the canvas is said out loud

parts.note: a sail is a sheet of canvas on a ship's mast

explanation.surface: A ship's sail turns up for bidding at an auction.
explanation.definitionFit: An auction is a kind of sale where goods go to the highest bidder.

clue.text: Hush up drink with journalists

parts.note: to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls
the press is the body of journalists

explanation.surface: Someone keeps a scandal quiet by taking reporters out for drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: To hush up a matter is to suppress it, keeping it from becoming known.

clue.text: Left with real estate

parts.note: and, like with, joins one thing to another

explanation.surface: Someone has been left a property in a will.
explanation.definitionFit: Real estate is property in the form of ground and buildings, so land is a synonym.

clue.text: See sign of lameness in G&S before the end of Ruddigore

indicators.note: before puts the first group of letters ahead of the final letter
in places the sign of lameness between the two letters of G&S

parts.note: G&S is Gilbert and Sullivan, giving the letters G and S
a limp is the sign that someone is lame

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter, here of Ruddigore

explanation.surface: A performer limps through a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta, Ruddigore, near its close.
explanation.walkthrough: Ruddigore is a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera; the clue uses G&S simply for its two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To glimpse something is to see it briefly, so the verb fits the single word see.

clue.text: Fifty I had crammed into short German aircraft

indicators.note: crammed into means these letters are pushed inside the shortened word
short means the word German is cut down to its opening letters

parts.note: the whole word German, cut back
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: Fifty passengers squeezed into a small German plane.
explanation.definitionFit: A glider is an engineless aircraft that flies on air currents.

clue.text: Emphatic about Conservative being self contradictory

indicators.note: about means the word for emphatic goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: being insistent is being emphatic and forceful

explanation.surface: A politician is emphatic about the Conservatives yet contradicts themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Something self-contradictory does not agree with itself, which is what being at odds internally means.

clue.text: Gasping about one work of art

indicators.note: about means the word for gasping wraps around the numeral

parts.note: panting is breathing hard, gasping
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A gallery visitor gasps at the sight of a single artwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A canvas made with paint is a classic example of a work of art.

clue.text: Border boundary of bushes needs top trimmed

indicators.note: a down entry's top is its first letter, so the opening letter is cut off

parts.note: a hedge is a boundary formed of bushes

explanation.surface: A garden border of shrubs needs a trim along the top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trimmed' suits a gardener and the hedge, but here it takes the first letter, H, away.
explanation.definitionFit: An edge is the border or rim of something, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Feeling one's not quite right moving a phony orchid

indicators.note: moving means the letters of these words are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone feels unwell because they have shifted a fake orchid.
explanation.definitionFit: Hypochondria is the persistent worry that one is ill, a feeling of being unwell without cause.

clue.text: Mean girl resorting to theft

parts.note: Penny is a girl's name
pinching is informal for stealing, theft

explanation.surface: A spiteful girl has taken to stealing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being stingy with money is described as penny-pinching, so it matches mean in the miserly sense.

clue.text: Unit working with energy

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A component that works with a power supply.
explanation.definitionFit: The number one is the unit, the single whole from which counting starts.

clue.text: What leads everyone to higher individual conduct?

definitions.text: What leads everyone to higher individual conduct?

indicators.note: the leads of words are their opening letters, taken from each of the five words that follow

explanation.surface: A question about what inspires people to behave better.
explanation.definitionFit: A moral code, or set of principles, is what guides a person toward better behaviour.

clue.text: Armorial bearings hardly unusual around the Queen

indicators.note: around means the shuffled letters go round the royal abbreviation
unusual means the letters of hardly are put in an odd order

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: Coats of arms around the Queen are hardly a rare sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hardly' reads as an adverb in the surface but is the fodder; ER (Elizabeth Regina) is the crossword's Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Heraldry covers coats of arms, which are also called armorial bearings.

clue.text: I pester about a short rest period

indicators.note: about means the letters are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone nags about getting a quick break.
explanation.definitionFit: A respite is a brief interval of relief, a short break from work or trouble.

clue.text: Ability to see certainly is needed in larger rowing boat

indicators.note: is needed in places the word for certainly inside the boat

parts.note: an eight is a racing boat for eight rowers, larger than a four
yes is a reply meaning certainly

explanation.surface: A rower in a big boat certainly needs to see well.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesight is vision, the faculty of seeing.

clue.text: Deal with other ranks having beer outside

indicators.note: outside means the beer goes on the outside of the military abbreviation

parts.note: stout is a dark beer
OR is the military abbreviation for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Enlisted soldiers drinking beer outdoors have to be dealt with.
explanation.definitionFit: To deal with a problem is to resolve or settle it, the meaning of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Troublesome fly is established and estimated on the rise

indicators.note: in a down answer, rising means reading from bottom to top

parts.note: EST is also the abbreviation for estimated

explanation.surface: A pest insect is said to be established and increasing in number.
explanation.definitionFit: The tsetse is an African fly whose bite spreads sleeping sickness, so troublesome indeed.

clue.text: Run into each other amidst cruise guests

indicators.note: amidst means the letters lie in the middle of the words that follow

explanation.surface: People bump into one another among passengers on a cruise.
explanation.definitionFit: To segue is to move smoothly from one thing into the next, as one piece of music flows into another.

clue.text: Group fixed stage scenery to mount sequence of songs

definitions.meaning: a collection of things belonging together
the scenery built for a play
the songs a band plays in one performance

explanation.surface: A band installs scenery before playing its run of songs.
explanation.walkthrough: Four separate meanings of one short word; 'to mount' only links them.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word covers a collection, something fixed, theatre scenery and a band's list of songs.

clue.text: Works for a couple lacking time as contribution to society perhaps

indicators.note: lacking means the letter for time is removed

parts.note: duets are musical works for two performers

explanation.surface: Musical pieces for pairs, short of time, as a gift to the community.
explanation.definitionFit: Membership fees paid to a club or society are its subscriptions, here as an example of payment.

clue.text: Small child needs me to hold it

indicators.note: to hold means the first word keeps the second inside it

explanation.surface: A little one wants a grown-up to hold something.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny youngster can be affectionately called a little one, a small creature.

clue.text: Realising redundant sign needs replacing

indicators.note: replacing means the letters of these words are placed again in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone notices that a sign no longer needed should be swapped out.
explanation.definitionFit: Realising something is coming to grasp or comprehend it, which is a gerund sense of the word.

clue.text: Observe conflict with European software that is intrusive

parts.note: to spy is to observe secretly
a war is an armed conflict

explanation.surface: Watching a European conflict through programs that pry.
explanation.definitionFit: Programs that secretly gather data about users are malicious and intrusive applications.

clue.text: Attend strike repeatedly

definitions.meaning: to attend an event is to ... it, read as two words
to hit again and again, as with a drum

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means to be present; as one it means to hit over and over.
